title: oreocarya johnstonii
intro: Oreocarya johnstonii, commonly known as Johnstons Oreocarya, is a species of flowering plant in the borage family that is native to the Andes mountains in South America. This plant has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, offering potential health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Oreocarya johnstonii include its ability to soothe and calm the body, making it a potential treatment for stress and anxiety. Bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
